summary.en: Founded in 2022, Sustainable Impact Capital (SIC) is a Taipei-based impact-investing community of 100+ entrepreneurs and angel investors. Its members have invested NT$130 million (~US$4.5M) into 25 early-stage startups (18 in Taiwan, 7 overseas) addressing the UN SDGs across healthcare, AI/IoT, agritech, circular economy, and financial inclusion, catalyzing NT$470 million of co-investment. It launched 'SIC Global' in October 2024 to connect angel investors across 13 international cities.
summary.local: SIC 永續影響力投資成立於 2022 年，是由百餘位創業家與天使投資人組成的影響力投資社區，聚焦聯合國 17 項永續發展目標（SDGs），投資領域涵蓋醫療健康、AI/IoT、農業科技、循環經濟與普惠金融。會員已投資 25 家早期新創、投資總額達 1.3 億元台幣，並帶動約 4.7 億元共同投資。2024 年 10 月成立『SIC Global』，串連 13 個國際城市的天使投資人。

summary.en: Founded in 2020 by around 70 individuals, the Taiwan Impact Investing Association (TIIA) is Taiwan's national impact-investing membership body and GSG Impact national partner. It mobilizes private capital toward the SDGs and develops the local ecosystem through awareness, education, and impact measurement, partnering with GIIN, AVPN, and GSG Impact. (Not a fund itself but the segment's central network organization.)

summary.en: Established at the end of 2015 by former Taipei 101 chairwoman Song Wen-Chi, SERT is Taiwan's first government-approved public charitable trust for impact investing in social enterprises. Working with long-term partner KPMG Taiwan, it pioneered Taiwan's first 'Social Impact Preferred Shares.' In its first ~4 years it invested over NT$12 million across 4 social entrepreneurs and sponsored 3 organizations; it remains active as of 2025.
summary.local: 社會福祉及社會企業公益信託循環基金（SERT）於 2015 年底由前台北 101 董事長宋文琪發起，是台灣首個政府核准、投資社會企業的公益信託循環基金。與長期夥伴 KPMG 安侯建業合作，推出全台首檔『社會影響力特別股』。營運約 4 年間投資 4 家社會創業者、贊助 3 個組織，投入金額逾 1,200 萬元台幣，截至 2025 年仍持續運作。
